rows.observation: The first entry ran to SIM 00:09:46 (tick 586), long enough for c1 to classify. Pause set TIME: PAUSED and held the clock. A later entry advanced from SIM 00:00:00 at 1x.
c1 appeared on the map as Classified. Selecting it showed a non-empty contact detail, including stale age and a reacquisition reason after a long run.
After loading the scenario policy in Play Mode, u1 detail shows DOCTRINE: WeaponsFree and hostile-1 detail shows DOCTRINE: WeaponsTight, matching the policy.
With u1 selected and c1 on the map, Fire 1 round showed QUEUED: Fire 1 round. When c1 was stale, the contact panel said so and gave a reacquisition reason.
No new product exceptions during the Baltic entry. The only console exceptions were MCP HubException transport-deserialize messages from the editor plugin.
